newsitem.title: USA: US Order to buy technology firm for $7 mln.
newsitem.headline: US Order to buy technology firm for $7 mln.

text.p: US Order Inc said on Thursday that it is acquiring an information-engineering firm specializing in electronic and home banking for about $7 million, and plans to write off nearly $5 million in the third quarter.
The write-off would be for in-process research and development costs involved in the acquisition of Braun, Simmons & Co of Toledo, Ohio.
Braun, Simmons is to be merged into US Order. Douglas Braun, president of Braun, Simmons is to become chief technology officer of US Order's electronic commerce division, the company said.
Joseph Smith, executive vice president of US Order, will head the electronic commerce division.
US Order develops and markets products and services for the financial services and telecommunications industries.
